mapper.select: select account_id, sealed_token, nonce, connected_at, claude_email, claude_org_id, claude_org_name, claude_subscription_type from builder.adk_builder_claude_credential where account_id = #{accountId}
select account_id from builder.adk_builder_claude_credential where lower(claude_email) = lower(#{email})
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_claude_credential (account_id, sealed_token, nonce, claude_email, claude_org_id, claude_org_name, claude_subscription_type) values (#{accountId}, #{sealedToken}, #{nonce}, #{claudeEmail}, #{claudeOrgId}, #{claudeOrgName}, #{claudeSubscriptionType})
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_claude_credential set sealed_token = #{sealedToken}, nonce = #{nonce}, connected_at = now(), claude_email = #{identity.email}, claude_org_id = #{identity.organizationId}, claude_org_name = #{identity.organizationName}, claude_subscription_type = #{identity.subscriptionType} where account_id = #{accountId}
